reasoning: Two acts in one turn. "С этого момента" and "всегда" settle a standing rule about how every future reply looks — a short plan, plain words, and where we stand shown each time — and that rule is recorded so it survives after any one task closes. But a standing rule for every future case does not absorb the demand for this one now: the plan does not exist yet, and the skill is explicit that when someone asks for a plan or a status they have asked for something to be made, and that it is work like any other. So the instruction half is accepted as one piece of work: write the short plan and show where we stand. One result, not two — the "where we are" view is that plan read back, not something that could ship or be cancelled on its own. Nothing is in flight this early in the session, so nothing is corrected and nothing is shelved. The only dimension the work genuinely touches is documentation and communication: a document is created and the shape of every report to him changes. No specialist is called — no behaviour, boundary, interface, evidence or outside fact changes, and routing a plan request to the communicator is exactly how a plain request disappears; the Director writes it and shows it itself.
